name: Kinugawa Toshiko
source: A client of the delivery service of whom [url=/c11723]Shoutaro[/url] is currently in charge. She is a mother of one child, and is currently three months pregnant with her second child. Toshiko seems to be loving sex in the same amount she loves her her husband and child. Since she recently didn't get enough of it, she has been compensating her lack of satisfaction by doing it with [url=/c11723]Shoutaro[/url]. Her breasts have increased in three sizes during pregnancy, boasting a rich amount of breast milk. As for her libido, she is now as hungry as ever.
